<!-- pr-reviewer: 1523bb2d08bc45c5503658e3109dda4ffe3668b3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Docs-only, not a code build.

What looks good
- Spot-checked against upstream/main (ce59ef446): AI Chat pane (View > Panels, provider presets, Offline only, disabled Attach screenshot, Confirmation required, Undo Turn, the confirm-first tool list, read-only banner), Open example and "No example projects", Machines kind filter incl. Waterjet, WCS tilt guard (Tilt about X/Y, Turn X+/X-/Y+/Y-, Level, Set Origin), Explain G-code, Tool library pane and "Tool library..." entry, Tool information, left-hand tap label, -Z C axis setup-sheet line, picked-ring refusal text. All present in source.
- The AI Chat text says plainly there is no live transport ("no live transport endpoint is configured for '<preset>'", matches transport.rs:100) and sends readers to an outside MCP agent.
- Waterjet text says no waterjet operation or post ships, so nothing can be posted.
- No unmerged PR is described; no snapshot PNGs; wording is original, no HSMWorks/Autodesk text.

Results (merged with main, locally; docs only)
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 24 tests, OK (pytest is not installed here, the tests are unittest).
- `zola build` in site/: clean, 43 pages.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking): no PROCESS_VERSION bump needed (no process files touched); the decision file is present.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
